findings.evidence: Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Function/LpSpace/ContinuousFunctions.lean:142 defines `ContinuousMap.toLp` as a `ContinuousLinearMap`; lines 193–233 of this file prove all six results solely by `simp [matrixCoeffLp]`.
findings.fix: Remove these six wrappers and use `map_zero`, `map_add`, and `map_smul` for `ContinuousMap.toLp`, together with the corresponding `matrixCoeff_*` simp lemmas at call sites; alternatively bundle the coefficient construction as a sesquilinear map so its laws come from the structure.
findings.issue: `matrixCoeffLp_zero_left`, `_zero_right`, `_add_left`, `_smul_left`, `_add_right`, and `_smul_right` are redundant public specializations of the linearity laws already available for `ContinuousMap.toLp`.

summary: The L² API duplicates generic linear-map laws already supplied by `ContinuousMap.toLp`.
